description: Mina is coordinating the preservation of a box of family cassette tapes and must decide which tapes to digitize, what equipment and format to use, when to hold the session, and how to store the originals after checking in with Leo and Sofia.

agents.name: Mina
agents.role: Family Archive Coordinator and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has 24 cassette tapes containing old conversations, songs, and recordings from relatives, and everyone wants a preservation plan.
shared_context.S2: Mina is coordinating the digitization session and will make the final decisions about the tapes, equipment, timing, file format, and storage.
shared_context.S3: The tapes are currently kept together in a labeled cardboard box at Mina's house.
shared_context.S4: Before Mina announces the plan, the family's usual practice is for Mina to call on Leo and then Sofia so each can share any practical information or preference that should shape the arrangement.
shared_context.S5: The digitization session will be informal and can be held at Mina's house.
shared_context.S6: For this session, the family follows the archivist's clearance literally: only tapes specifically named in the archivist's recommendation are put into the digitization batch, while any tapes not named wait for a later review.
shared_context.S7: As part of the family's normal planning routine, Mina repeats any outside recommendation in her own words before finalizing and writes a short checklist recording each person's concrete task, including who will bring and use borrowed equipment.

PF1.text: Leo owns a working Type I cassette deck that he can lend for the session, but he can bring it only on Saturday between 10:00 and 14:00.

PF2.text: Sofia spoke with Mei, a local archivist, who reviewed the tape labels and recommended digitizing tapes 1 through 18 at 24-bit WAV quality and storing the original cassettes in an acid-free box; Mei's recommendation has not reached the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly tapes 1 through 18 must be selected for digitization, because the family puts only tapes named in the archivist's clearance into this session's batch.
Leo's working Type I cassette deck must be selected as the equipment.
The session must be scheduled for Saturday from 10:00 to 14:00.
The files must be created in 24-bit WAV format.
The original cassettes must be stored in an acid-free box.
A checklist commitment naming Leo must say that Leo will bring and use his Type I cassette deck during the session.
Mina must cite Sofia's explicitly revealed archivist recommendation in the settlement.

content_checks.C2: ('Leo' in decisions['equipment']) and ('Type I' in decisions['equipment']) and ('cassette deck' in decisions['equipment'])
content_checks.C3: ('Saturday' in decisions['session_time']) and ('10:00' in decisions['session_time']) and ('14:00' in decisions['session_time'])
content_checks.C4: decisions['file_format'] == '24-bit WAV' or decisions['file_format'] == '24-bit_WAV' or decisions['file_format'] == '24-bit wav'
content_checks.C5: ('acid-free' in decisions['original_storage']) or ('Acid-free' in decisions['original_storage']) or ('acid_free' in decisions['original_storage'])
content_checks.C6: any((c['type'] == 'equipment' or c['type'] == 'equipment_lending' or c['type'] == 'equipment_loan') and c['target'] == 'Leo' and ('bring' in c['detail']) and ('use' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: ('PF2' in justification_fact_ids or 'Sofia:PF2' in justification_fact_ids) and ('PF2' in revealed or 'Sofia:PF2' in revealed)

decisive_facts.why: Leo's specific Type I deck changes the equipment choice, his Saturday 10:00-14:00 availability changes the session window, and his lending it supplies the named bring-and-use equipment task.

Sofia's archivist recommendation changes the batch to exactly tapes 1 through 18, sets the format to 24-bit WAV, changes storage to an acid-free box, and supplies the recommendation Mina must cite after Sofia says it aloud.
